motivation: Opus identified legacy per-voxel coverage as a single-member spread statistic rather than a frequentist calibration frequency over independent truth seeds.

legacy_metric.definition: fraction of voxels in one member inside that member's 16-draw field standard deviation

proposed_metric.definition: for each latent coefficient mode, fraction of independent development seeds whose truth coefficient lies inside the member posterior interval
proposed_metric.interval68: posterior mean +/- one posterior draw standard deviation
proposed_metric.interval95: posterior mean +/- 1.96 posterior draw standard deviations

contract_boundary.required_next: post-provenance primary Opus audit before any contract adoption
